senses.definition: vb.denom. remain in harvest-time (so Arabic خَرَفَ; Eng. to winter)—only
Impf. 3 fs. כָּל־בֶּהֱמַת הָאָרֶץ עָלָיו תֶּחֱרָ֑ף Is 18:6 all the beasts of the earth shall spend the harvest-time upon it.
